about: SCION 46 asset ledger: every piece in the picture and the sound, where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it.

assets.what: the dog's four head plates (three-quarter front 45, side 90, three-quarter back 135, back 180), each with its landmark vector
assets.source: drawn for this film (build/plates.py, Catmull-Rom outlines in metres)
assets.operation: drawn; placed per frame only by an affine least-squares fit of its landmarks to the solver's projected head landmarks; chosen by view-matching on the head's azimuth (hysteresis 7 deg)
assets.note: coat colours (tan, dark saddle, white collar/chest/blaze) chosen after looking at the home-movie dog in kit/archive-dog (Amateur Film New Jersey C); no pixels of it are used

assets.what: three torso plates (side 90, three-quarter back 135, back 180)
assets.operation: drawn; affine fit to projected torso landmarks; view-matched; mirrored views arise from the fit itself

assets.what: ears (inner/outer), eyes (almond, iris, pupil, lid), mouth, neck with collar, four limbs, paws, tail
assets.operation: ears and neck by two-point fits (base to tip, neck pivot to skull pivot); eyes, lid and mouth as controls inside the head plate's frame; limbs as one outline through the solved pivot chain; tail as a five-pivot chain

assets.what: the person's face: a cartoon profile (nose, lips, chin), three mouth states
assets.source_title: We Learn About the Telephone I
assets.operation: SAM mask cut; landmarks hand-annotated; registration between mouth frames measured (upper-face edge, residual 0-1 px); placed by similarity fit only (no shear); graded by the scene's light; mouth chosen per frame from the voice's syllable envelope
assets.note: a drawn cartoon, not a real person's photographed face

assets.what: the person's coat, legs, arms, hands, cranium, hair, ear and hat
assets.operation: drawn in the face portrait's own pixel frame (cranium, hat, ear) and as limbs through a solved skeleton; the hat brim covers exactly the forehead the source frame never showed

assets.what: the door panel with its curtained window and knob
assets.operation: panel quad annotated by hand; rectified by a projective fit; mirrored (hinge side); a plain drawn head rail added where the source frame ends; re-projected each frame by a projective fit onto the swinging panel

assets.what: house, cut-away room, lamp, picture frame, rug, porch, steps, railing, fence, treeline, sky, moon, stars, light spill and shadows
assets.operation: world geometry in metres projected through the frame camera; light spill = the lit doorway projected from the lamp onto the porch; shadows = the dog's and person's landmarks projected from the lamp

assets.what: voice (formant synthesis of timed syllables), paws (one per solved foot contact), door creak, room hum and clock, collar tag, breath, wind and crickets
assets.operation: synthesized; voice syllables shared with the face's mouth control; paws from cache/contacts.json
read: x, state, act intentions, person and door timeline

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, Literata, JetBrains Mono (cards only)
assets.rights: as provided by the repo (SIL OFL fonts)

assets.operation: looked at only (coat and markings reference); not used in the picture

not_used: no Quick, Draw! drawings, no archive-dog pixels, no web images, no model-generated images, no real person's photographed face
